# Screenshots

Drop real captures here, mirroring the path used in the Markdown.

For example, an article that writes:

    ![The New asset form](/screenshots/assets/create-asset.png)

is satisfied by a file at:

    public/screenshots/assets/create-asset.png

Until that file exists the manual renders a labelled placeholder in its place,
and the written steps stand on their own. No Markdown change is needed on the
day a screenshot is added.

Nothing in this directory is fabricated. If an image is not here, it has not
been captured yet.
